stdout_normalized:
usage: runtime/scripts/cli.py [-h] [--root ROOT] [--engine-root ENGINE_ROOT]
                              {install,doctor,guard,style,engine,demo,capabilities,sessions,open,inspect,read-region,render,geometry,render-prepare,events,modules,module-check,propose,validate,plan,request-approval,approval,approve,reject,apply,candidates,compare,receipt,verify,ui}
                              ...

Drive the Runtime domain layer from the command line. One JSON document per
invocation on stdout.

positional arguments:
  {install,doctor,guard,style,engine,demo,capabilities,sessions,open,inspect,read-region,render,geometry,render-prepare,events,modules,module-check,propose,validate,plan,request-approval,approval,approve,reject,apply,candidates,compare,receipt,verify,ui}
    install             bootstrap engine and distribution modules from bundle
                        zips
    doctor              read-only installed-product prerequisites and engine
                        checks
    guard               did an edit change a number, quote, negation, ...?
                        (.hwpx, .txt, .md; no root needed)
    style               Korean phrasing worth a second look (.hwpx, .txt, .md;
                        no root needed)
    engine              is the separately installed HWP engine available
                        (optional)
    demo                run self-contained end-to-end demonstrations
    capabilities        what this build can do
    sessions            list sessions under the root
    open                validate and copy a document into a session
    inspect             summary, graph and editable regions
    read-region         exact text and runs for named regions
    render              a page image, or why there cannot be one
    geometry            text positions on a page, mapped to addresses
    render-prepare      convert the session copy to a PDF so render can raster
                        it (host action; needs Hancom)
    events              read the session event log
    modules             distribution modules on disk and what they contribute
    module-check        run a distribution module's checkers against a
                        session's document
    propose             build an OperationPlan
    validate            validate a plan without executing it
    plan                read a plan back
    request-approval    open an approval for a plan
    approval            read an approval back
    approve             resolve an approval as approved
    reject              resolve an approval as rejected
    apply               execute an approved plan, publish a candidate
    candidates          published candidates for a session
    compare             compare a candidate with another candidate or the
                        source at named addresses; how a reversal is proven
    receipt             read a receipt; refuses on byte drift
    verify              re-run the offline checks; fail closed
    ui                  launch the local web UI bridge server

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --root ROOT           directory the Runtime may write under (sessions,
                        plans, approvals, candidates). No default, ever.
  --engine-root ENGINE_ROOT
                        repo root holding engine/scripts and pipeline/scripts
                        (default: this checkout)
